**Facility-fee shield:** ~8,119 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 8 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~231,600 patients across 193 at-risk practices statewide.
